presets.name: Soft Studio
presets.description: Matte single-color backdrop, floor plane, soft gradient light.
presets.prompt: empty product photography studio, seamless matte {color} backdrop with a soft vertical gradient, smooth tabletop floor plane, soft diffused key light from the left, gentle falloff, minimal, clean commercial look
presets.negative: product, bottle, can, box, text, logo, watermark, people, hands, clutter

video_prompt.subtle: static locked-off camera, the soft studio light very slowly brightens and dims on the backdrop, no camera movement
video_prompt.balanced: static locked-off camera, soft light slowly sweeps across the backdrop, gentle gradient shift, no camera movement

presets.name: Neon Studio
presets.description: Dark studio with neon lines in the background.
presets.prompt: empty dark product photography studio, glossy black floor, thin {color} neon light lines on the far back wall, moody rim light, haze, cinematic commercial look
presets.negative: product, bottle, can, box, text, logo, watermark, people, hands, neon in foreground, light beams over the center

video_prompt.subtle: static locked-off camera, background neon lines slowly pulse, faint haze drifts in the back, no camera movement
video_prompt.balanced: static locked-off camera, background neon lines pulse and shift brightness, haze slowly drifts, no camera movement

presets.name: Botanical
presets.description: Leaves and natural light in the background.
presets.prompt: empty product photography set, light stone pedestal surface, out-of-focus green leaves in the far background, natural window sunlight with {color} tones, soft bokeh, fresh organic commercial look
presets.negative: product, bottle, can, box, text, logo, watermark, people, hands, leaves in the foreground, leaves covering the center

video_prompt.subtle: static locked-off camera, leaf shadows sway very slightly in the background, bokeh drifts slowly, no camera movement
video_prompt.balanced: static locked-off camera, background leaves sway gently in a breeze, dappled light moves slowly, no camera movement
